blocks.text:
1. Get Data for relevant time lines: Filter to the required timehorizon by filtering 
 REQUESTED_DELIVERY_DT between dates  that are returned  (IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_CALENDAR_HORIZON_CORE.CALENDAR_DT WHERE IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_CALENDAR_HORIZON_CORE.HORIZON_CORE_CD=IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_THREE_TXT WHERE SUBJECT_AREA_NM='PURCHASE DOCUMENT' and ENTITY_NM='STOCK TRANSFER ORDER' AND BUSINESS_RULE_NM='STO_Config' )
2. Document Types: Filter  IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_LINE.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_TYPE_CD=IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT WHERE STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_TYPE_CD=IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT WHERE SUBJECT_AREA_NM='PURCHASE DOCUMENT' and ENTITY_NM='STOCK TRANSFER ORDER' AND BUSINESS_RULE_NM='STO_Config'  for the coresponding SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM IN COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT
3. Exclude Marked to Delete: Exclude rows that have IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_LINE.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_DELETION_STATUS_CD!= ''
and
 Exclude rows that have IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_LINE.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_DELETION_STATUS_CD !=''
4. Delivery Complete Indicator: Include rows  with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_LINE.DELIVERY_COMPLETE_IND='N'
5. Join above results with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.PURCHASE_REQUISITION_PURCHASE_ORDER_ASSOCIATION based on  PURCHASE_ORDER_NBR=STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_NBR and STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_NBR=PURCHASE_ORDER_LINE_NBR to get the corresponding PURCHASE REQUISITION AND PURCHASE REQUISITION LINE NBR for the STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_NBR
6. Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_LINE and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_SCHEDULE_LINE based on  STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_NBR	and  STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_NBR. Aggregate GOODS_ISSUED_QTY and GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY
7a. SUPPLYING_PLANT_CODE: Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_LINE with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT based on SUPPLYING_PLANT_CODE=LEGACY_PLANT_CD. Use  V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT.PLANT_CD. If null continue to use the SUPPLYING_PLANT_CODE

7b. RECEIVING_PLANT_CD & PLANT_CD: :Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.SOURCE_TO_PAY_ANALYSIS.STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_LINE with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT based on RECEIVING_PLANT_CD / PLANT_CD=LEGACY_PLANT_CD. Use  V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT.PLANT_CD. If null continue to use the SUPPLYING_PLANT_CODE/PLANT_CD
7. DESTSTATUS: IF GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY =0 THEN 'OPEN' (1)
ELSEIF STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_QTY-GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY >0 THEN 'PARTIAL' (2)
ELSE 'COMPLETE' (3)

SOURCESTATUS: IF GOODS_ISSUED_QTY =0 THEN 'OPEN' (1)
ELSEIF STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_QTY-GOODS_ISSUED_QTY >0 THEN 'PARTIAL' (2)
ELSE 'COMPLETE' (3)
DQ: Join Above results with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_SUPPLY_PLANNING_XFRM.V_PRM_ITEM_TRANSPORTATION_ROUTE_PARAMETER_CORE_PIT based on ITEM_ID, FROM_LOCATION_ID=SUPPLYING_PLANT_CD , TO_LOCATION_ID=RECEIVING_PLANT_CD to get Valid Item and routes only
